newsitem.title: FRANCE: Valeo creates clutch venture in India.
newsitem.headline: Valeo creates clutch venture in India.

text.p: French car parts manufacturer Valeo said on Wednesday it had struck an agreement with Amalgamations Ltd of India to create a joint venture to produce clutches.
"The new firm, Amalgamations Valeo Clutch Ltd, will be held 50-50 by Valeo and Amalgamations," it said in a statement.
Valeo said the venture would produce clutches for cars and trucks for Indian manufacturers and also for foreign producers at a site near Madras.
It said Amalgamations was the leading producer of clutches in India.
Valeo generated 28.8 billion francs in sales last year, 68 percent of that outside France.
